description: This file defines a Perl class for a ResultSet related to 'Tag' in a database schema, including methods for joining, filtering by names, and ungrouped tags.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Tag
classes.description: A Perl class representing a ResultSet for 'Tag' entities in the database schema, providing methods for data retrieval and filtering.

methods.name: joined
methods.description: Concatenates all 'name' column values in the ResultSet into a single space-separated string.

methods.name: from_names
methods.description: Filters the ResultSet to include tags whose 'name' is in the provided list of names.

methods.name: ungrouped
methods.description: Filters the ResultSet to include tags that are not part of any group (i.e., 'tag_group' is undefined).
